- **Decor that does something** (`OfficeActivity.decorPanel`): a wall clock (live face), a window (a painted view,
  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:
  its audio plays on the player's card, ⏹ stops) and a VHS player (a tape runs on the screen its ⚙ picks — else the
  first screen, else a window; ⏹ on the screen gives it back its picture). "+ Today board" on the control panel adds
  a screen showing the Day Page. Shelf items carry `src` (the file's url) for the players.
- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.
- A held book / record / tape shows a card (cover + title) above it; letting go away from the shelf opens the reader
  THERE, at reading height, facing you.
- **Move furniture** (main panel switch, off at every start): only while it is on do pieces show their bar, ⚙ and
  🗑, or move at all — so grabbing a book never moves the shelf.
- Controls (`OfficeActivity.InputSystem`), all smooth while the stick is held, and ONLY on the piece whose bar you
  hold (nothing is ever selected by pointing or tapping): RIGHT stick left/right turns it, up/down pushes it further
  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.

  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:
  its audio plays on the player's card, ⏹ stops) and a VHS player (a tape runs on the screen its ⚙ picks — else the
  first screen, else a window; ⏹ on the screen gives it back its picture). "+ Today board" on the control panel adds
  a screen showing the Day Page. Shelf items carry `src` (the file's url) for the players.

  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

  THERE, at reading height, facing you.

  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.

  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:

  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:
  its audio plays on the player's card, ⏹ stops) and a VHS player (a tape runs on the screen its ⚙ picks — else the
  first screen, else a window; ⏹ on the screen gives it back its picture). "+ Today board" on the control panel adds
  a screen showing the Day Page. Shelf items carry `src` (the file's url) for the players.
- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

  THERE, at reading height, facing you.

  🗑, or move at all — so grabbing a book never moves the shelf.

  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.

  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:
  its audio plays on the player's card, ⏹ stops) and a VHS player (a tape runs on the screen its ⚙ picks — else the
  first screen, else a window; ⏹ on the screen gives it back its picture). "+ Today board" on the control panel adds
  a screen showing the Day Page. Shelf items carry `src` (the file's url) for the players.

  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:
  its audio plays on the player's card, ⏹ stops) and a VHS player (a tape runs on the screen its ⚙ picks — else the
  first screen, else a window; ⏹ on the screen gives it back its picture). "+ Today board" on the control panel adds
  a screen showing the Day Page. Shelf items carry `src` (the file's url) for the players.
- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

  THERE, at reading height, facing you.
- **Move furniture** (main panel switch, off at every start): only while it is on do pieces show their bar, ⚙ and

  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.

  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:

  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:
  its audio plays on the player's card, ⏹ stops) and a VHS player (a tape runs on the screen its ⚙ picks — else the
  first screen, else a window; ⏹ on the screen gives it back its picture). "+ Today board" on the control panel adds
  a screen showing the Day Page. Shelf items carry `src` (the file's url) for the players.

  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

  THERE, at reading height, facing you.

  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.

  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:

  a screen showing the Day Page. Shelf items carry `src` (the file's url) for the players.

  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:
  its audio plays on the player's card, ⏹ stops) and a VHS player (a tape runs on the screen its ⚙ picks — else the
  first screen, else a window; ⏹ on the screen gives it back its picture). "+ Today board" on the control panel adds
  a screen showing the Day Page. Shelf items carry `src` (the file's url) for the players.

  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:
  its audio plays on the player's card, ⏹ stops) and a VHS player (a tape runs on the screen its ⚙ picks — else the
  first screen, else a window; ⏹ on the screen gives it back its picture). "+ Today board" on the control panel adds
  a screen showing the Day Page. Shelf items carry `src` (the file's url) for the players.
- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.
- A held book / record / tape shows a card (cover + title) above it; letting go away from the shelf opens the reader
  THERE, at reading height, facing you.
- **Move furniture** (main panel switch, off at every start): only while it is on do pieces show their bar, ⚙ and
  🗑, or move at all — so grabbing a book never moves the shelf.

  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.

  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:
  its audio plays on the player's card, ⏹ stops) and a VHS player (a tape runs on the screen its ⚙ picks — else the
  first screen, else a window; ⏹ on the screen gives it back its picture). "+ Today board" on the control panel adds
  a screen showing the Day Page. Shelf items carry `src` (the file's url) for the players.

  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:
  its audio plays on the player's card, ⏹ stops) and a VHS player (a tape runs on the screen its ⚙ picks — else the
  first screen, else a window; ⏹ on the screen gives it back its picture). "+ Today board" on the control panel adds
  a screen showing the Day Page. Shelf items carry `src` (the file's url) for the players.
- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.
- A held book / record / tape shows a card (cover + title) above it; letting go away from the shelf opens the reader
  THERE, at reading height, facing you.
- **Move furniture** (main panel switch, off at every start): only while it is on do pieces show their bar, ⚙ and
  🗑, or move at all — so grabbing a book never moves the shelf.
- Controls (`OfficeActivity.InputSystem`), all smooth while the stick is held, and ONLY on the piece whose bar you
  hold (nothing is ever selected by pointing or tapping): RIGHT stick left/right turns it, up/down pushes it further
  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.

  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:
  its audio plays on the player's card, ⏹ stops) and a VHS player (a tape runs on the screen its ⚙ picks — else the
  first screen, else a window; ⏹ on the screen gives it back its picture). "+ Today board" on the control panel adds
  a screen showing the Day Page. Shelf items carry `src` (the file's url) for the players.
- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.
- A held book / record / tape shows a card (cover + title) above it; letting go away from the shelf opens the reader
  THERE, at reading height, facing you.
- **Move furniture** (main panel switch, off at every start): only while it is on do pieces show their bar, ⚙ and
  🗑, or move at all — so grabbing a book never moves the shelf.

  hold (nothing is ever selected by pointing or tapping): RIGHT stick left/right turns it, up/down pushes it further
  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.

  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:

  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:
  its audio plays on the player's card, ⏹ stops) and a VHS player (a tape runs on the screen its ⚙ picks — else the
  first screen, else a window; ⏹ on the screen gives it back its picture). "+ Today board" on the control panel adds
  a screen showing the Day Page. Shelf items carry `src` (the file's url) for the players.

  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

  THERE, at reading height, facing you.

  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.

  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:
  its audio plays on the player's card, ⏹ stops) and a VHS player (a tape runs on the screen its ⚙ picks — else the
  first screen, else a window; ⏹ on the screen gives it back its picture). "+ Today board" on the control panel adds
  a screen showing the Day Page. Shelf items carry `src` (the file's url) for the players.
- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

  THERE, at reading height, facing you.
- **Move furniture** (main panel switch, off at every start): only while it is on do pieces show their bar, ⚙ and
  🗑, or move at all — so grabbing a book never moves the shelf.

  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.

  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:
  its audio plays on the player's card, ⏹ stops) and a VHS player (a tape runs on the screen its ⚙ picks — else the
  first screen, else a window; ⏹ on the screen gives it back its picture). "+ Today board" on the control panel adds
  a screen showing the Day Page. Shelf items carry `src` (the file's url) for the players.

  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

  THERE, at reading height, facing you.

  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.

  a screen showing the Day Page. Shelf items carry `src` (the file's url) for the players.

  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:
  its audio plays on the player's card, ⏹ stops) and a VHS player (a tape runs on the screen its ⚙ picks — else the
  first screen, else a window; ⏹ on the screen gives it back its picture). "+ Today board" on the control panel adds
  a screen showing the Day Page. Shelf items carry `src` (the file's url) for the players.

  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

  THERE, at reading height, facing you.

  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.

  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:
  its audio plays on the player's card, ⏹ stops) and a VHS player (a tape runs on the screen its ⚙ picks — else the
  first screen, else a window; ⏹ on the screen gives it back its picture). "+ Today board" on the control panel adds
  a screen showing the Day Page. Shelf items carry `src` (the file's url) for the players.

  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:
  its audio plays on the player's card, ⏹ stops) and a VHS player (a tape runs on the screen its ⚙ picks — else the
  first screen, else a window; ⏹ on the screen gives it back its picture). "+ Today board" on the control panel adds
  a screen showing the Day Page. Shelf items carry `src` (the file's url) for the players.
- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.
- A held book / record / tape shows a card (cover + title) above it; letting go away from the shelf opens the reader
  THERE, at reading height, facing you.
- **Move furniture** (main panel switch, off at every start): only while it is on do pieces show their bar, ⚙ and
  🗑, or move at all — so grabbing a book never moves the shelf.
- Controls (`OfficeActivity.InputSystem`), all smooth while the stick is held, and ONLY on the piece whose bar you
  hold (nothing is ever selected by pointing or tapping): RIGHT stick left/right turns it, up/down pushes it further
  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.

  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:
  its audio plays on the player's card, ⏹ stops) and a VHS player (a tape runs on the screen its ⚙ picks — else the
  first screen, else a window; ⏹ on the screen gives it back its picture). "+ Today board" on the control panel adds
  a screen showing the Day Page. Shelf items carry `src` (the file's url) for the players.

  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

  THERE, at reading height, facing you.

  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.

  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:
  its audio plays on the player's card, ⏹ stops) and a VHS player (a tape runs on the screen its ⚙ picks — else the
  first screen, else a window; ⏹ on the screen gives it back its picture). "+ Today board" on the control panel adds
  a screen showing the Day Page. Shelf items carry `src` (the file's url) for the players.
- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.
- A held book / record / tape shows a card (cover + title) above it; letting go away from the shelf opens the reader
  THERE, at reading height, facing you.
- **Move furniture** (main panel switch, off at every start): only while it is on do pieces show their bar, ⚙ and
  🗑, or move at all — so grabbing a book never moves the shelf.

  hold (nothing is ever selected by pointing or tapping): RIGHT stick left/right turns it, up/down pushes it further
  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.

  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:
  its audio plays on the player's card, ⏹ stops) and a VHS player (a tape runs on the screen its ⚙ picks — else the

  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:
  its audio plays on the player's card, ⏹ stops) and a VHS player (a tape runs on the screen its ⚙ picks — else the

  a screen showing the Day Page. Shelf items carry `src` (the file's url) for the players.

  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:
  its audio plays on the player's card, ⏹ stops) and a VHS player (a tape runs on the screen its ⚙ picks — else the
  first screen, else a window; ⏹ on the screen gives it back its picture). "+ Today board" on the control panel adds
  a screen showing the Day Page. Shelf items carry `src` (the file's url) for the players.

  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

  THERE, at reading height, facing you.

  🗑, or move at all — so grabbing a book never moves the shelf.

  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.

  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:
  its audio plays on the player's card, ⏹ stops) and a VHS player (a tape runs on the screen its ⚙ picks — else the
  first screen, else a window; ⏹ on the screen gives it back its picture). "+ Today board" on the control panel adds
  a screen showing the Day Page. Shelf items carry `src` (the file's url) for the players.
- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.
- A held book / record / tape shows a card (cover + title) above it; letting go away from the shelf opens the reader
  THERE, at reading height, facing you.
- **Move furniture** (main panel switch, off at every start): only while it is on do pieces show their bar, ⚙ and
  🗑, or move at all — so grabbing a book never moves the shelf.
- Controls (`OfficeActivity.InputSystem`), all smooth while the stick is held, and ONLY on the piece whose bar you
  hold (nothing is ever selected by pointing or tapping): RIGHT stick left/right turns it, up/down pushes it further
  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.

  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:
  its audio plays on the player's card, ⏹ stops) and a VHS player (a tape runs on the screen its ⚙ picks — else the
  first screen, else a window; ⏹ on the screen gives it back its picture). "+ Today board" on the control panel adds
  a screen showing the Day Page. Shelf items carry `src` (the file's url) for the players.

  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

  THERE, at reading height, facing you.

  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.

  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:
  its audio plays on the player's card, ⏹ stops) and a VHS player (a tape runs on the screen its ⚙ picks — else the
  first screen, else a window; ⏹ on the screen gives it back its picture). "+ Today board" on the control panel adds
  a screen showing the Day Page. Shelf items carry `src` (the file's url) for the players.

  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

  THERE, at reading height, facing you.

  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.

  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:
  its audio plays on the player's card, ⏹ stops) and a VHS player (a tape runs on the screen its ⚙ picks — else the
  first screen, else a window; ⏹ on the screen gives it back its picture). "+ Today board" on the control panel adds
  a screen showing the Day Page. Shelf items carry `src` (the file's url) for the players.
- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.
- A held book / record / tape shows a card (cover + title) above it; letting go away from the shelf opens the reader
  THERE, at reading height, facing you.
- **Move furniture** (main panel switch, off at every start): only while it is on do pieces show their bar, ⚙ and
  🗑, or move at all — so grabbing a book never moves the shelf.
- Controls (`OfficeActivity.InputSystem`), all smooth while the stick is held, and ONLY on the piece whose bar you
  hold (nothing is ever selected by pointing or tapping): RIGHT stick left/right turns it, up/down pushes it further
  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.

  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:
  its audio plays on the player's card, ⏹ stops) and a VHS player (a tape runs on the screen its ⚙ picks — else the
  first screen, else a window; ⏹ on the screen gives it back its picture). "+ Today board" on the control panel adds
  a screen showing the Day Page. Shelf items carry `src` (the file's url) for the players.

  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

  THERE, at reading height, facing you.
- **Move furniture** (main panel switch, off at every start): only while it is on do pieces show their bar, ⚙ and
  🗑, or move at all — so grabbing a book never moves the shelf.

  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.

  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:
  its audio plays on the player's card, ⏹ stops) and a VHS player (a tape runs on the screen its ⚙ picks — else the
  first screen, else a window; ⏹ on the screen gives it back its picture). "+ Today board" on the control panel adds
  a screen showing the Day Page. Shelf items carry `src` (the file's url) for the players.
- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

  THERE, at reading height, facing you.
- **Move furniture** (main panel switch, off at every start): only while it is on do pieces show their bar, ⚙ and
  🗑, or move at all — so grabbing a book never moves the shelf.

  hold (nothing is ever selected by pointing or tapping): RIGHT stick left/right turns it, up/down pushes it further
  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.

  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:
  its audio plays on the player's card, ⏹ stops) and a VHS player (a tape runs on the screen its ⚙ picks — else the
  first screen, else a window; ⏹ on the screen gives it back its picture). "+ Today board" on the control panel adds
  a screen showing the Day Page. Shelf items carry `src` (the file's url) for the players.
- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.
- A held book / record / tape shows a card (cover + title) above it; letting go away from the shelf opens the reader
  THERE, at reading height, facing you.
- **Move furniture** (main panel switch, off at every start): only while it is on do pieces show their bar, ⚙ and
  🗑, or move at all — so grabbing a book never moves the shelf.
- Controls (`OfficeActivity.InputSystem`), all smooth while the stick is held, and ONLY on the piece whose bar you
  hold (nothing is ever selected by pointing or tapping): RIGHT stick left/right turns it, up/down pushes it further
  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.

  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:
  its audio plays on the player's card, ⏹ stops) and a VHS player (a tape runs on the screen its ⚙ picks — else the
  first screen, else a window; ⏹ on the screen gives it back its picture). "+ Today board" on the control panel adds
  a screen showing the Day Page. Shelf items carry `src` (the file's url) for the players.
- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.
- A held book / record / tape shows a card (cover + title) above it; letting go away from the shelf opens the reader
  THERE, at reading height, facing you.
- **Move furniture** (main panel switch, off at every start): only while it is on do pieces show their bar, ⚙ and
  🗑, or move at all — so grabbing a book never moves the shelf.

  hold (nothing is ever selected by pointing or tapping): RIGHT stick left/right turns it, up/down pushes it further
  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.

  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:
  its audio plays on the player's card, ⏹ stops) and a VHS player (a tape runs on the screen its ⚙ picks — else the
  first screen, else a window; ⏹ on the screen gives it back its picture). "+ Today board" on the control panel adds
  a screen showing the Day Page. Shelf items carry `src` (the file's url) for the players.

  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

  THERE, at reading height, facing you.

  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.

  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:
  its audio plays on the player's card, ⏹ stops) and a VHS player (a tape runs on the screen its ⚙ picks — else the
  first screen, else a window; ⏹ on the screen gives it back its picture). "+ Today board" on the control panel adds
  a screen showing the Day Page. Shelf items carry `src` (the file's url) for the players.
- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.

  THERE, at reading height, facing you.
- **Move furniture** (main panel switch, off at every start): only while it is on do pieces show their bar, ⚙ and
  🗑, or move at all — so grabbing a book never moves the shelf.

  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.

  `tools/windowView.py` → `assets/office/window_view.jpg`), a record player (let go of a record within 0.5m of it:
  its audio plays on the player's card, ⏹ stops) and a VHS player (a tape runs on the screen its ⚙ picks — else the
  first screen, else a window; ⏹ on the screen gives it back its picture). "+ Today board" on the control panel adds
  a screen showing the Day Page. Shelf items carry `src` (the file's url) for the players.
- **Layout backup:** the app sends its placements + decor to the control panel (at most every 5s, when changed),
  which saves them on the grid (`PUT /api/v1/vr/layout` → `grid.meta.vrLayout`). A headset with nothing for the
  grid (wiped, reinstalled, new) restores from it; a headset's own copy always wins.
- A held book / record / tape shows a card (cover + title) above it; letting go away from the shelf opens the reader
  THERE, at reading height, facing you.
- **Move furniture** (main panel switch, off at every start): only while it is on do pieces show their bar, ⚙ and
  🗑, or move at all — so grabbing a book never moves the shelf.
- Controls (`OfficeActivity.InputSystem`), all smooth while the stick is held, and ONLY on the piece whose bar you
  hold (nothing is ever selected by pointing or tapping): RIGHT stick left/right turns it, up/down pushes it further
  away / pulls it closer; LEFT stick up/down grows / shrinks it (0.3x–3x, saved with its pose). Pieces can be carried into the air but not below the floor. The SDK's
  own stick locomotion (snap turn) is switched off.
